tbesh_html:
1) to hear, listen
1a) (Hiphil)
1a1) to hear, listen, give ear
1a2) to be obedient, harken
1a3) to hear or listen to prayers (of God)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to broaden out the ear (with the hand), i.e. (by implication) to listen
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; probably to expand; but used only as a denominative from H241 (אֹזֶן);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: give (perceive by the) ear, hear(-ken). See H239 (אָזַן).
